channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Com crise no STF, Congresso quer votar reforma do Judiciário após a eleição
item.description: The STF crisis may drive a Judiciary reform after the 2026 elections. Lawmakers and judiciary members consider it inevitable to vote on changes to the rules of superior courts. A pending constitutional amendment proposes an eight-year term for Supreme Court justices and shared appointments among the branches of government.

item.title: Lula será único líder dos Brics fundadores fora de cúpula na Índia
item.description: Lula will be the only founding BRICS leader absent from the summit in New Delhi due to his election campaign, while the other leaders are confirmed to attend the event.

item.title: Os reflexos da ascensão da direita na América Latina na eleição do Brasil
item.description: The rise of right-wing governments across Latin America, now controlling 7 countries representing 58.3% of South America's population, shapes Brazilian electoral discourse for 2026 but domestic factors remain decisive.

item.title: Lula desfalca cúpula dos Brics com Putin e Xi Jinping na Índia
item.description: The BRICS summit in New Delhi gathers nearly all leaders, except Brazil, represented only by lower-level officials. Lula cites the electoral calendar and prioritizes the UN in New York. Putin and Xi Jinping attend, while legal restrictions limit some leaders' participation.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP neste sábado (12/9)
item.description: On Saturday (September 12), seven candidates for the governorship of São Paulo continue their electoral campaign activities ahead of the 2026 elections. Incumbent Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and former minister Fernando Haddad (PT) lead the polls and hold events across the state. Haddad launches his health policy platform in São Paulo, while Tarcísio attends events in Olímpia.

item.title: Confira as agendas dos candidatos à Presidência neste sábado (12/9)
item.description: Presidential candidates hold electoral events across various states on Saturday, with activities including rallies, meetings with supporters, and campaign recordings. Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema, Renan Santos, Caiado, and Augusto Cury follow different schedules, while Caiado has no public commitments.

item.title: Perucas, figurino, hospedagens: veja gastos de 'Dark Horse', filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Documents from the 'Master' investigation reveal that the production of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, spent R$ 20.9 million in Brazil, including R$ 1.4 million on hotels and R$ 10 thousand on wig rental for Jim Caviezel.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro tentou quatro vezes redirecionar de Dino para Mendonça investigação sobre 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense team attempted four times to redirect the 'Dark Horse' investigation to Minister André Mendonça, alleging jurisdictional manipulation by the STF. The PF also conducted 49 raids linked to an alleged scheme of misusing parliamentary amendments to fund the film.

item.title: Cliente 'assíduo' com 'elevado nível de exigências': Vorcaro gastou US$ 55 milhões em turismo de luxo em um ano
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, former banker at Banco Master, spent $55.3 million on luxury tourism services between November 2024 and December 2025, according to documents from Signature Luxury Services LLC. The company described him as an 'assiduous' client with a 'high level of demands', with requests handled directly by manager Leonardo Serrano Giunchetti. Payments were made through a brokerage in the Bahamas and included accommodations, artist bookings, and high-end concierge services.

item.title: Produtora de 'Dark Horse' pagou ao menos quatro faturas de cartão de crédito de Mário Frias durante produção do filme
item.description: The production company Go Up Entertainment, responsible for the biographical film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro, paid at least four credit card bills of federal deputy Mário Frias between August and November 2025, as revealed in investigations authorized by the STF. The amounts ranged from R$32,600 to R$36,800, raising suspicions of public fund misappropriation through parliamentary amendments.

item.title: Investigação aponta que empresa da produtora de 'Dark Horse' antecipou instalação de wi-fi em SP durante eleições de 2024
item.description: São Paulo police investigate the Conhecer Brasil Institute, linked to the 'Dark Horse' producer, over irregular advance installation of Wi-Fi points during the 2024 municipal elections, suspecting political interference and a R$26 million loss to the city government. The case prompted Minister Flávio Dino to order a federal police inquiry and freeze payments to the institute, as Mayor Ricardo Nunes considers legal action.

item.title: PF identificou US$ 12,3 milhões enviados a fundo ligado a “Dark Horse”
item.description: Federal Police identified $12.3 million sent from a company linked to Master Bank to a US fund financing the film 'Dark Horse', a biography of Jair Bolsonaro. The funds were allegedly managed under guidance from Eduardo Bolsonaro and monitored by Flávio Bolsonaro, who denies any wrongdoing. Authorities are investigating potential charges including money laundering and corruption.

item.title: Flávio e Vorcaro trocaram imagens temporárias antes de prisão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro exchanged temporary images the day before the banker’s arrest, investigated for alleged crimes linked to the financing of the film 'Dark Horse'. The Federal Police are probing possible money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption, with Flávio identified as Vorcaro’s direct intermediary in the funding negotiations.

item.title: ‘Apesar da tempestade, vou até o fim com isso’, disse Vorcaro sobre filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Former banker Daniel Vorcaro assured ally Thiago Miranda that he maintained funding for the 'Dark Horse' film about Jair Bolsonaro despite the risk of Banco Master being liquidated by the Central Bank. Messages reveal direct communication between Vorcaro, Flávio Bolsonaro, and the producer, showing attempts to resolve payment delays during a fraudulent billion-dollar operation involving Banco de Brasília. Minister André Mendonça authorized the release of investigations, expanding the political and institutional scandal.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': produtor dos EUA de filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro diz que só entrega documentos à PF com ordem da Justiça americana
item.description: Michael Davis, the U.S. producer of the film 'Dark Horse', stated he will not authorize the release of company documents to Brazilian authorities without a U.S. court order, requiring formal legal cooperation between the countries. The producer emphasized the need for mutual legal assistance or a letter rogatory to validate any request. The Brazilian Federal Police had requested information from producer Karina Ferreira da Gama to investigate the funding of the biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: QUEM SUBIRÁ A RAMPA? LULA OU FLÁVIO NO JOGO DAS BOLINHAS! #Flávio, #LuladaSilva
item.description: The content presents a political analysis involving Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting the context of the 2026 elections and competition between different figures in the Brazilian political landscape. The narrative suggests a direct confrontation between leaders from different party currents. The tone is electrifying, focused on future political disputes.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha mostra Lula com 46% e Flávio Bolsonaro com 44% em um possível 2º turno
item.description: A new Datafolha poll reveals a tight technical tie between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a hypothetical presidential runoff, with 46% and 44% of voter intent, respectively. The margin of error is 2 percentage points, making the electoral scenario even more uncertain.

item.title: Levantar sigilo do caso Master foi medida acertada
item.description: The President of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Edson Fachin, made the right decision by ordering the lifting of the seal on the Banco Master case, demanding the release of all previously classified documents, including investigations into the film 'Dark horse' and Jaques Wagner's ties to a former Banco Master partner. The ruling corrected initial omissions and ensured greater transparency in investigating the financial institution's irregularities.

item.title: Tabela obtida pela PF mostra detalhes sobre os gastos para produção de Dark Horse
item.description: A document attached to the 'Dark Horse' investigation, which probes Flávio Bolsonaro, reveals details of the budget for a film honoring Jair Bolsonaro, funded by Daniel Vorcaro. The documents show a total budget of 25 million dollars, with expenses spread across development, pre-production, filming, and post-production. The disclosure of an audio recording in which Flávio asks Vorcaro for money led to the opening of an investigation by the Federal Police at the request of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Vorcaro ofereceu casa para jantar com ator e diretor do filme
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro offered his house for a dinner with actor Jim Caviezel and director Cyrus Nowrasteh, arranged by Flávio Bolsonaro on November 6, 2025. The Federal Police investigate the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', with resources managed by Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Por que eleitor demorou a saber de investigação sobre Flávio?
item.description: The criminal investigation into Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was authorized on July 22, three days before his presidential candidacy, but the electorate only learned about it nearly two months later. The delay in information disclosure is due to judicial security protocols and restrictions on publicizing ongoing investigations. The probe involves allegations of money laundering, currency evasion, and passive corruption.

item.title: Minha mãe para o STF
item.description: The text satirizes the author's mother, D. Conceição, who would be 96 years old, as an obstacle to running for the STF. Despite this, she is praised for her reputation, legal knowledge, and Brazilian nationality. The article is exclusive and ironizes the possibility of her appointment, especially to the presidency.

item.title: Flávio agradeceu a Vorcaro por bancar filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Leaked messages from the Brazilian Federal Police reveal that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro thanked Daniel Vorcaro, from Banco Master, for funding the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. The exchange included payment demands and negotiation attempts, with Vorcaro arrested in an operation investigating multimillion-dollar fraud.

item.title: VÍDEO: Como saber se meu título de eleitor está regular?
item.description: Voters can check the status of their voter registration through the TSE's Online Self-Service portal using their full name, voter ID number, or CPF. A 'regular' status allows voting; 'canceled' or 'suspended' statuses restrict voting rights, but the system provides tools for resolving issues.

item.title: Datafolha 1º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião no cenário sem Pablo Marçal
item.description: Datafolha poll released on September 11 shows Lula (PT) leading the first round with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 35%. The survey, commissioned by Globo and Folha, interviewed 2,002 people between September 8 and 10, with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: De fraude no BRB a escândalo político: o que as investigações do Caso Master revelam até agora
item.description: The Master Case, involving suspicions of a billion-dollar fraud at BRB, triggered a political scandal during the 2026 election year, with investigations pointing to connections between the former bank owner, Daniel Vorcaro, and figures from the judiciary and legislature, including Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Deputado estadual, deputado federal e senador: o que fazem, quanto ganham e qual a diferença entre eles?
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil will renew positions such as state deputy, federal deputy, and senator, each with distinct responsibilities at the state, federal, and Senate levels. State and federal deputies serve four-year terms in their respective legislative chambers, while senators serve eight-year terms and hold exclusive powers, including judging authorities and approving presidential appointments.

item.title: A primeira pesquisa presidencial após a derrubada do sigilo do caso Master no STF
item.description: Quaest will release the first presidential poll after the Supreme Court lifted the secrecy of the Master case. The survey, commissioned by Grupo Globo, has a margin of error of two percentage points and 95% confidence. In the previous poll, Lula leads with 36%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 29%.

item.title: Flávio pediu ajuda a Vorcaro na véspera de prisão
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked entrepreneur Daniel Vorcaro for help financing the film 'Dark Horse', one day before Vorcaro's arrest on November 16, 2025. The Federal Police identified Flávio as an intermediary in securing funds for the production, with messages and payment demands. The PF requests investigation into possible money laundering and currency evasion crimes.

item.title: PF quer apurar atuação de Flávio, Eduardo e Mario Frias
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating potential crimes related to the financing of the film 'Dark Horse,' including money laundering and foreign exchange evasion, involving Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, and Mario Frias. Data from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and information from Coaf revealed an international financial structure in the transactions.

item.title: Eduardo deu instruções sobre como dinheiro do Dark Horse deveria ser gerido nos EUA
item.description: Documents reveal that former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro gave instructions on managing millions of dollars allocated to the film 'Dark Horse,' a biopic of former president Jair Bolsonaro, while exiled in the U.S. Investigations suggest suspected fund diversions involving figures such as ad man Thiago Miranda and ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Em jogo eletrizante, Coritiba e Athletico-PR empatam pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Coritiba and Athletico-PR drew 3-3 in the 27th round of the Brazilian Championship at Couto Pereira. Goals scored by Tiago Cóser (2) and Moledo (2) for Coritiba, and Luiz Gustavo, Arthur Dias, and Viveros for Athletico-PR. Athletico-PR remained in 3rd place with 46 points, while Coritiba stayed in 7th place with 38 points.

item.title: ‘Fala irmãozão’, ‘a caminho’ e ‘imagina a gente dando um calote’, relatório da PF sobre Dark Horse mostra mensagens de Flávio cobrando Vorcaro
item.description: A Federal Police report reveals messages in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro demands businessman Daniel Vorcaro for payments to finance the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro. The conversations suggest possible face-to-face meetings between the two and the involvement of Thiago Miranda as an intermediary, with requests for R$ 131 million, of which R$ 60 million has already been paid.

item.title: Vorcaro chamou pagamento do filme “Dark Horse” de “mais importante”
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, described the $62.3 million payment for the film 'Dark Horse' as the most important campaign contribution for Jair Bolsonaro. The investigation shows Flávio Bolsonaro acted as intermediary and Vorcaro demanded payment of the 'obligation'. Minister André Mendonça lifted secrecy on the case files after pressure from the PGR.

item.title: “Vou até o fim com isso”, disse Vorcaro sobre financiamento de Dark Horse
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro stated he would fully fund the movie 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro despite payment delays. Messages reveal that Flávio Bolsonaro pressured for funds for production and that Coaf identified seven transfers totaling $12.33 million linked to the financing. The investigation points to potential irregularities in fundraising for the film.

item.title: Sem Lula, cúpula do Brics marca reaproximação entre Índia e China após confronto
item.description: At the BRICS summit in New Delhi, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's absence created room for a rapprochement between India and China, marked by Xi Jinping's visit after military clashes in 2019. The gathering reinforced BRICS as an alternative to Western institutions, with the bloc expanding to include new members such as Iran and the UAE.

item.title: STF: acesso a tudo! Mendonça é Vazador Oficial? Adie-se a sessão de 3ª
item.description: Edson Fachin, presidente do STF, ordered Minister André Mendonça to forward all procedures related to the Master Case to the Court, following requests from the PGR and Alexandre de Moraes. The decision makes Mendonça an 'Official Leaker' by authorizing investigations against Moraes, risking the breach of essential secrecy measures.

item.title: Quebra de sigilo do Master expõe Flávio Bolsonaro investigado e gera nova troca de ataques no STF
item.description: The release of secrecy in the Banco Master case exposes Flávio Bolsonaro as investigated, escalating confrontations among Supreme Court justices and deepening the institutional crisis under Edson Fachin's leadership.

item.title: Lula diz que cobrará Trump na ONU por respeito às eleições do Brasil
item.description: President Lula said he will urge Trump to respect Brazilian elections at the U.N. General Assembly, emphasizing sovereignty and rejecting foreign interference. He may also discuss U.S. trade tariffs on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Sócio de Vorcaro tratou de ‘emenda Master’ com líder do governo Lula no Senado
item.description: The Federal Police found evidence of corruption involving the former partner of Banco Master, Augusto Lima, and Senator Jaques Wagner, who was the government leader in the Senate. Messages suggest Wagner received improper benefits, including an apartment and bank transfers. The case is linked to the 'Master amendment' and the largest banking fraud in Brazilian history.

item.title: Produção de Dark Horse esperava arrecadar até R$ 500 milhões em bilheteria
item.description: Federal Police investigate money laundering suspicions in the production of Jair Bolsonaro's biopic 'Dark Horse', whose business plan projected revenues of up to R$512 million. The PF notes these projections exceed the national box office record by over threefold, suggesting financial irregularities.

item.title: Relatório da PF cita encontros entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro em 2025
item.description: A Federal Police report indicates that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro met in person with Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, in August and September 2025, as part of investigations into funding for the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Lula compara baixa representação feminina na política ao apartheid
item.description: President Lula compared the low female representation in Brazilian politics to the apartheid regime in South Africa during a campaign event in Porto Alegre. He questioned why women, despite being the majority in society, are underrepresented in political offices and advocated for voting for women, while cautioning about their political stances. Lula indirectly referenced Carla Zambelli, criticizing voters who support figures linked to violent actions.

item.title: Lula diz que governo Bolsonaro “criou” Vorcaro: “Bandido virou banqueiro”
item.description: Lula claimed the Banco Master scandal was created during Bolsonaro's government, calling Daniel Vorcaro a 'criminal who became a banker' in 2019 and highlighting his arrest during his term. During a campaign event in Porto Alegre, he emphasized the need to fight lies in elections and highlighted anti-corruption actions in Social Security.

item.title: Lula sobe o tom e reage à crise: 'No meu mandato, Vorcaro virou prisioneiro'
item.description: Lula raises his tone at a rally in Porto Alegre and links the Banco Master scandal to the Bolsonaro government, claiming Daniel Vorcaro was arrested during his term. The president also supports opening a CPI into pension fraud and warns Trump not to interfere in Brazilian elections.

item.title: AO VIVO: LULA EM PORTO ALEGRE (RS)- ELEIÇÕES 2026
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva takes part in a live event in Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, as part of his political agenda toward the 2026 elections. The content of the broadcast is not available for detailed analysis, but the moment reinforces his presence in the regional and national electoral landscape.

item.title: Lula diz que dará recado a Trump na ONU: 'Eu não me meto nas eleições americanas e gosto de ser respeitado'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that he does not accept U.S. interference in Brazilian elections and intends to convey this stance to President Donald Trump during the United Nations General Assembly. Speaking at a campaign event in Porto Alegre, Lula emphasized that the far-right, represented by Trump, has sought to influence elections across Latin America and reiterated his commitment to maintaining civil diplomatic relations with the United States.

item.title: Fernando Diniz prepara estreia de joia em Flamengo x Corinthians
item.description: Corinthians coach Fernando Diniz is set to debut 17-year-old defender Iago Machado in the match against Flamengo in the Brazilian Championship. The highly rated youngster may pair up with João Pedro Tchoca in a rotated lineup for the game.

item.title: Veja como foi a sexta-feira (11) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Friday (11), presidential candidates held town halls, interviews, and campaign events. Lula advocates for full-time schools, while Zema proposes treating criminal factions as terrorists. Caiado was hospitalized with pneumonia, and other candidates had varied schedules.

item.title: Mendonça quebra sigilo de investigação sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e financiamento do 'Dark Horse'
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça lifted the secrecy of 39 processes involving Banco Master, including the investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro's funding of the film 'Dark Horse'. The decision enhances transparency in electoral investigations.
